decision: KEEP Node/ECMAScript comparison harness and build-time AJV; FIX unequal validator coverage and separate correctness from timing.
constraints: Compare the same scene, health and session validators in fresh Node processes using the shipped JSON schema and compiler. No network, unbounded corpus or runtime change.

Provide a one-round correctness-only CI path with no benchmark samples; retain a separate three-round shared-host measurement mode. Pin probe, fixture, schema, generated code and dependency lock bytes.

alternatives.assessment: KEEP: measures the actual JavaScript runtime and generated AJV exports directly; source-based comparison checks all three validator contracts. Build-time standalone compilation avoids runtime Function compilation.

Credible typed host integration and explicit JSON access, but would still call the same Node/AJV APIs. No independent oracle or measured runtime advantage follows from a compiler change for this small process harness.
Exports JavaScript-callable APIs and maps selected types to JavaScript. Static interop does not validate the authoritative JSON Schema at runtime or replace actual Node cold-load evidence.

A credible cross-language client boundary; compiling a harness adds a generated boundary while it must still launch the actual Node workload. No Dart target or shared implementation requirement materially improves this measurement component.

limits: Both branches use AJV: agreement is migration parity, not independent schema correctness. Independent negative admission tests remain required.

ready_ms includes module loading and, for runtime mode, schema parsing/compilation; warm_ms measures scene validation only. RSS delta is process RSS change, not peak memory. Shared-host measurements are not hard real-time or hardware qualification.
Correctness-only mode publishes no timing samples. This review does not refresh historical benchmark results or compare alternative source compilers.
A controlled altered generated validator tests report rejection; no production service, sensor, actuation, MLS/CNSA, uptime or customer-install claim.
